entities.name: Luc Urbain de Bouexic, comte de Guichen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luc Urbain du Bouëxic, comte de Guichen was a French Navy officer who commanded the fleets that fought the Royal Navy at the Battle of Ushant and Battle of Martinique during the American Revolutionary War.
